description: Every 5 minutes, or when called: publishes each approved post whose time has come to the Facebook page. A post is marked publishing before any call, so a failed save can never post it twice. Posts with pictures the manager sent in Lark: each picture is downloaded from Lark, uploaded to Facebook unpublished and attached to the post; if none uploads, the post goes out as text. Saves the Facebook id and format and sends the link to Lark; a refused post becomes publish_failed with Facebook's reason in check_report.
name: Content agent: publisher

parameters.jsCode:
const post = $json;
return post.pictures.slice(0, 10).map((p) => ({ json: { ...p, post_id: post.Id } }));
